principle: User proposes capabilities; Wayfinder records requirements and decisions in GitHub Issues; delivery uses accepted issues and tested steps.

milestones.name: Prove first delivery
milestones.outcome: Deliver CLI help in yumo-plugins through deliver-feature-chain, with tests and an operator-created pull request. The pdlc dev dry run proves compatibility only; no full-engine delivery is claimed.

milestones.name: Feature pull request
milestones.outcome: Deliver a feature in regime-ledger as an external consumer project, and check required CI on the pull request current head commit.

milestones.name: Independent model review
milestones.outcome: Use a separate reviewer to find and verify a real defect on a consumer project pull request.

milestones.name: Cross-provider routing
milestones.outcome: Record the reviewer, evidence, and resulting decision across selected providers.

milestones.name: Reliable local resume
milestones.outcome: Resume interrupted pull request and CI work from recorded state without repeating completed side effects.

milestones.name: Controlled release
milestones.outcome: Use a controlled release path after the core workflow works.

milestones.name: Personal governance
milestones.outcome: Show decisions and delivery evidence clearly, with the selected approval policy.

milestones.name: Pilot and hardening
milestones.outcome: Run the accepted workflow in another project and address defects found by the pilot.
